Class RouxEngine

java.lang.Object
org.roux.RouxEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryLifecycleManager, MemoryStateController
@Component public class RouxEngine extends Object implements MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryStateController, MemoryLifecycleManager
Roux is the paged memory beside the terminal. The RouxEngine type is that memory. One region is stored for each conversation id. The type implements MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryStateController, and MemoryLifecycleManager. A region holds the hot page, the off-heap index, and the map from a RouxId to a message id. The hot page receives writes. A disk region publishes through RegionPack. A memory-only region stays mapped and does not take a pack lock. A caller opens a region, appends a message, reads a window, and closes the region. The type refuses an empty conversation id. The type refuses a snapshot, a heap dump, and defragment in this version. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxEngine roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • openRam

      public OpenResult openRam(String regionId)
      The method opens a memory-only region. A null id or an empty id returns a refused OpenResult with invalid region. The id is added to the memory-only set before the region is created. An id that is already open returns a new-kind result for that region's UUID. A new id is allocated with a capacity hint of 0. A missing region after that allocation returns a refused result with region not found. The result kind is new for both a fresh id and an id that was already open. The method does not take a pack lock and does not create a spill directory. // @aa-sdd G-08 G-09 Q-S1-1 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id to open.
      Returns:
      The result is a new-kind open, or a refusal.

    • allocateRegion

      public AllocationResult allocateRegion(String regionId, long capacityHintBytes)
      The method creates a region or returns the one already stored. A null id or an empty id fails with AllocationStatus.OUT_OF_ADDRESS_SPACE and regionId required. An id that is already stored succeeds and describes that region. A new region uses pageBytes(), increments the allocated-page counter, and loads the head prefix. The capacity hint is not read.
      Specified by:
      allocateRegion in interface MemoryLayoutManager
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      capacityHintBytes - The hint is accepted and not used.
      Returns:
      The result is success with a RegionDescriptor, or the empty-id failure.

    • growHotPage

      public AllocationResult growHotPage(String regionId)
      The method rotates the hot page. A missing region fails with AllocationStatus.OUT_OF_ADDRESS_SPACE and region not found. A failed rotation returns AllocationStatus.SEVERE_FRAGMENTATION, the rotation message, and the current descriptor. The previous hot page remains when rotation fails. A successful rotation returns AllocationStatus.SUCCESS and the new descriptor.
      Specified by:
      growHotPage in interface MemoryLayoutManager
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The result describes the region after the attempt.

    • appendMessage

      public OperationResult appendMessage(String regionId, byte role, long timestampEpochMs, int tokenCount, String text)
      The method appends one message frame on the hot page. The region is allocated first, and the capacity hint is 0. A missing region returns OperationStatus.NOT_FOUND and region not found. The payload is encoded by ToonCodec. A frame larger than maxFrameBytes() returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and frame larger than max-frame-bytes. A new RouxId is minted for the message. The wait for the region lock is added to the lock-wait counter. A hot page that cannot hold the frame is rotated first. A failed rotation is returned as that failure. A page that is still too small returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and hot page too small. The frame type is FrameType.MSG. The message id is the region's next id, and that id then advances by one. The first frame on a page stores the first message id. The last message id on the page becomes this message id. The index row and the identity map both record the new id. The appended-frame counter and the index-entry counter each advance by one. Durability append with an enabled pack publishes the hot page. The page pin is released before the method returns. Success uses an empty message. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxEngine roux-v1.md
      Specified by:
      appendMessage in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      role - The role is the role byte stored in the frame.
      timestampEpochMs - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored in the frame.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored in the frame.
      text - The text is the message body.
      Returns:
      The result is success, or the failure from allocation, size, or rotation.

    • clearRegion

      public void clearRegion(String regionId)
      The method drops the frames and keeps the region. A missing region returns without a change. The pages are closed, the index is reset, and the identity map is cleared. The next message id becomes 1. A new hot page 0 is stored, and the next page id becomes 1. The allocated-page counter increments. A memory-only process recounts the used bytes and returns. Any other process wipes the pack, writes the manifest, and then recounts.
      Specified by:
      clearRegion in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.

    • tryAcquireLock

      public LockToken tryAcquireLock(String regionId, int level, long timeoutMs)
      The method tries to take the region lock. A missing region returns null. The wait is timeoutMs milliseconds. A timeout returns null. An interrupt returns null and sets the interrupt status on this thread. The token id is a random UUID string. The level is stored on the token and does not change the branch. The token is stored as the operator lock. The region lock stays held until releaseLock(LockToken).
      Specified by:
      tryAcquireLock in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      level - The level is stored on the token.
      timeoutMs - The timeout is the wait in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The token is the held lock, or null when the lock was not taken.

      public boolean releaseLock(LockToken token)

      Specified by:
      releaseLock in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:

    • readRaw

      public void readRaw(MemoryAddress address, MemorySegment dest)
      The method copies bytes from a mapped page into a destination. A null address or a null destination returns without a copy. A missing region returns without a copy. A missing page, or a page with no segment, increments the stale-view counter and returns. The copy length is the address length. A length larger than the destination is cut to the destination size. The copy starts at the address offset and lands at offset 0 in the destination.
      Specified by:
      readRaw in interface MemoryInspector
      Parameters:
      address - The address names the region, the page, the offset, and the length.
      dest - The destination receives the copied bytes.

    • openRegion

      public OpenResult openRegion(String regionId)
      The method opens a region or restores one from the pack. A null id or an empty id is refused with invalid username. A memory-only process allocates the id and returns a new-kind result. A missing region after that allocation is refused with region not found. An id that is already in the region map is refused with session already open for plus the id. A pack lock that is not acquired uses that same refusal. A new region keeps the pack lock. No pack file and no manifest file allocates the id and returns a new-kind result. A failed allocation unlocks the pack and is refused with region not found. Restore turned off unlocks the pack. The refusal is roux restore disabled; leftover pack not attached; delete plus the directory plus or enable restore. A manifest file without a pack file uses the incomplete-pack refusal. That refusal is roux pack incomplete or corrupt; delete plus the directory plus or revert yaml. A manifest that cannot be read, a null manifest, a format version other than PageHeader.VERSION, or an owner that is not empty and not this id uses that same refusal. A page size that differs from pageBytes() is refused with roux pack page-bytes mismatch (manifest plus the manifest size plus , yaml plus the engine size plus ). A pack with no manifest is restored by restoreFromPack(String, RegionManifest) with a null manifest. A matching pack and manifest is restored with that manifest. A refused restore unlocks the pack. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxEngine roux-v1.md // @aa-sdd GK-1043 roux-l2.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The result is new, restored, or refused.

    • persistClose

      public OperationResult persistClose(String regionId)
      The method closes one region. A missing region returns success with already closed. A region that is already closed returns that same success. A memory-only process, or an id opened through openRam(String), destroys the region and removes the id. That path returns success with closed. Persist on publishes the hot page, writes the manifest, saves the head prefix, destroys the region, and unlocks the pack. The files stay. Persist off destroys the region and deletes the region directory. Both disk paths mark the region closed, remove the id, and return success with closed. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxEngine roux-v1.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The result is success with already closed or closed.
